privilege_issues.rationale: Unauthenticated access to public endpoints enables privilege escalation and unauthorized data access.

privilege_issues.issue: Majority of data flows lack input validation
privilege_issues.rationale: Unvalidated inputs can be exploited for SQL injection, command injection, or other code execution attacks.

suggestions.reason: Unauthenticated entry points expose the application to unauthorized access
suggestions.recommendation: Apply authentication middleware to all public routes; use JWT tokens or OAuth2

suggestions.reason: Unvalidated input flows create SQL injection and command injection vectors
suggestions.recommendation: Implement parameterized queries and schema validation at controller boundaries

db.session.execute(select(User).where(User.id == int(user_id)))
# NOT string interpolation

suggestions.recommendation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with consistent enforcement across all sensitive operations
